name: TED API
operator: Publications Office of the European Union
scope: EU public procurement notices and eForms workflows
notes: Use for notice search/retrieval in MVP before any publication or submission workflow.

name: Datenservice Oeffentlicher Einkauf - Bekanntmachungsservice

name: service.bund.de Ausschreibungsinformationen

notes: Keep as a fallback/reference source while prioritizing the central Bekanntmachungsservice.
